_readme: Ve's file: the model, turn cap and time limit of each kind of claude session (run-loop.ps1 starts one session per job). Edit by hand; the loop only reads it. Missing or empty values fall back to the defaults in gate-rules.ps1 ($SessionDefaults). A build uses build.smallModel when its issue carries one of build.smallLabels, else build.model. run-loop.ps1 -Model / -MaxTurns override every session for one run.
